entities.name: Olgard
entities.description: Famed slayer and shieldbearer, noble agent of the Skiltfolk of Nephalia and father of Mia; leader of the coastal resistance against Emrakul.

entities.name: Mia
entities.description: Olgard's daughter, who became a cultist of the Gitrog monster.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: Eldrazi whose corrupting influence the resistance opposed.

entities.name: Travails
entities.description: Time of Emrakul's corruption of Innistrad.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: Coastal region lined with smaller battlefields.

events.summary: Olgard leaves Mia in charge of their farm to serve the Skiltfolk; villagers fall to the Gitrog monster and Mia becomes a cultist.
events.quote: his daughter became one of its cultists

events.summary: Olgard becomes a leader of the resistance on Nephalia's coast, organizing and training defenders.
events.quote: became a leader of this resistance

relations.quote: He is the father of the Gitrog monster cultist Mia
